content_sections.heading: Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 579 Land Record Assistant posts are notified, with the following category-wise breakup as received from the District Commissioners (except Sixth Schedule areas). Within the total, 173 posts are reserved for Ex-Servicemen (horizontal reservation) and 16 posts are reserved for Persons with Disability across sub-categories PH-A (7), PH-B (3), PH-C (4), and PH-D (2). The vacancy figures shown are as per category-wise vacancies received from the District Commissioners; note that the horizontal PH and Ex-Servicemen reservation figures are drawn from within the vertical category totals, not in addition to them.

content_sections.heading: Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the Recorders Certificate Class Course (RCCC) Training from the Assam Survey & Settlement Training Centre, Dakhingaon, Guwahati-40, in the mandated examination, with an official result declared by the Director of Land Records & Surveys, Assam, covering both Survey and Settlement subjects, prior to the commencement of Government Notification No. LA&A/429557/158 dated 13.08.2026. Candidates must have proficiency in the use of computers, with a minimum typing speed of 30 WPM in English and 15 WPM in Assamese/Bengali. This recruitment is restricted to candidates who have already completed the RCCC Training and cleared the mandated examination prior to the specified cut-off - it is not open to candidates without this prior training/certification.

content_sections.heading: Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should not be less than 21 years and not more than 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026. Age relaxation for reserved category candidates is applicable as per Government OM No. ABP.6/2016/51, dated 02.09.2020. The age limit will be calculated based on the Class-X/Class-XII Examination Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Mark Sheet issued by a recognised Central/State Board/Council, where age/date of birth is clearly mentioned.

content_sections.heading: Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a competitive examination comprising two components, for a total of 100 marks. The Written Examination carries negative marking of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer. A practical test assessing both English and Assamese or Bengali typing. Candidates whose applications are accepted will be shortlisted and notified in due course to appear for the Written Examination (MCQ pattern) on a date/time to be notified. Candidates who clear the category-wise minimum qualifying marks in the Written Examination, in a ratio decided by the Selection Board, will be called for the Skill Test. Only candidates declared qualified by the Selection Board on the basis of the Written Examination will appear for the Skill Test. After the Skill Test, shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification, where they must produce original documents along with self-attested copies. The final merit list is prepared on the aggregate marks of the Written Examination and Skill Test, subject to candidates securing the prescribed minimum qualifying marks in both components and fulfilling all eligibility conditions upon document verification. Selection is strictly on merit and applicable category-wise reservation. Mere availability of vacancies does not entitle any candidate to selection, and vacancies may remain unfilled if insufficient candidates secure the minimum qualifying marks.

Candidates already in Central/State Government service should apply through proper channel and must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their respective Heads of Department at the time of document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. DLR-11013(21)/50/2025/372, dated 19.09.2026, issued by the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys, Assam, for filling 579 vacant posts of Land Record Assistant (LRA) under District Commissioners' offices across Assam (except Sixth Schedule areas).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 579 total vacancies, distributed across UR, OBC/MOBC, OBC(T), ST(P), ST(H), SC, and EWS categories, with horizontal reservation for Ex-Servicemen (173) and Persons with Disability (16).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes at 5:00 PM on 21.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Land Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: Only candidates who have already completed the 6-month RCCC (Recorders Certificate Class Course) Training at the Assam Survey & Settlement Training Centre and have been declared proficient in Survey and Settlement subjects prior to 13.08.2026 are eligible - this is not open to candidates without prior RCCC training.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026, with age relaxation for reserved categories as per applicable Government orders.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Written Examination (80 marks, MCQ, with 0.25 negative marking) covering Mathematics, Conventional Survey, and Modern Survey, followed by a Computer Skill Test (20 marks) and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Land Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: The pay scale is PB-2 (₹14,000–₹70,000) plus Grade Pay of ₹6,200, along with usual allowances admissible under Government of Assam rules.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for Assam DLRS Land Record Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply only through https://sebaonline.org, log in, fill the application form, upload the required documents (photo, signature, RCCC certificate), and submit before the closing date.
